qa_pairs.question: When requesting cloud resources for the Resource Allocation Competition 2026, what is the procedure if I require them from more than one location?
qa_pairs.answer: If you need to request cloud resources in more than one location, you must make a separate request for each location on the CCDB portal.

qa_pairs.question: What types of virtual machines (VMs) can be selected on the Arbutus, Fir, Béluga, and Nibi clouds for the Resource Allocation Competition 2026?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Arbutus, Fir, and Béluga clouds, you can select either compute or persistent virtual machines (VMs). However, for the Nibi cloud, only persistent VMs are available for selection. Each cloud resource on CCDB will also display the specific 'flavours' of VMs available for its particular site.
